verdict_meaning: the natural-population panel has no grouping that is BOTH fold-compatible (largest cluster <= 1/k) and not mostly singletons, so grouped CV cannot be run on it at all. The instrument is built and NOT calibrated. Unblock = a natural-population panel whose relatedness is not concentrated in one clump (a USER decision: it means acquiring a substrate, e.g. the 1001-Genomes genotype matrix).

control_selection.rule: BY CONSTRUCTION from each panel's `design` field, declared before any number was read; NOT by pc1 (see the census pc1_selection_verdict)
control_selection.negative_basis: by construction: a single BY x RM cross, recombination randomizes ancestry; this is the F3 NEGATIVE control
control_selection.positive_basis: by sampling: inbred lines drawn from ONE natural Drosophila population (Raleigh), with documented cryptic relatedness
control_selection.positive_fold_incompatibility_reason: no percentile on the ladder yields a usable grouping -- p1: 165cl largest=0.02 single=0.84; p2: 154cl largest=0.03 single=0.83; p5: 138cl largest=0.05 single=0.79; p10: 110cl largest=0.10 single=0.74; p15: 100cl largest=0.10 single=0.69; p20: 89cl largest=0.13 single=0.70; p25: 79cl largest=0.19 single=0.66; p30: 69cl largest=0.20 single=0.67; p40: 44cl largest=0.30 single=0.57; p50: 35cl largest=0.34 single=0.60; p60: 27cl largest=0.52 single=0.48; p70: 21cl largest=0.65 single=0.43. The panel has no scale at which clusters are neither dominant nor mostly singletons.

criterion: DIFFERENTIAL: negative control keeps beating its own grouped null AND the positive control's paired per-trait drop exceeds the negative control's. Asserts no magnitude.
honest_limits: The two controls have DIFFERENT traits, so the between-control comparison is two-sample, not paired; the within-control sign tests are paired.
The positive control's structure is MEASURED while the negative control's randomization is BY CONSTRUCTION -- a deliberate asymmetry in evidence strength.
IBS-greedy-representative is ONE grouping. An INVALID_INSENSITIVE verdict could be the grouping's blindness rather than the instrument's insensitivity.
n_perm=100 bounds the resolution of every beats_null decision.
MIN_TRAITS_FOR_SIGN_TEST and MAX_TRAITS are ASSERTED, not derived.
metrics_withheld: This run is blocked, so NO calibration metrics are emitted. A blocked verdict is a pre-registered outcome of this plan, not a partial result to be read as one.
